newsitem.title: USA: Yields fall on Bond Buyer's weekly indices.
newsitem.headline: Yields fall on Bond Buyer's weekly indices.

text.p: Yields on the Bond Buyer municipal bond indices fell this week.
The yield on the 20-bond index of general obligation bonds calculated Thursday, Dec 26, was 5.66 percent, down one basis point from last week.
The yield on the 11-bond index of GO bonds was 5.56 percent, also down one basis point from last week.
The yield on the 30-year revenue bond index was 5.92 percent, three basis points lower than last week.
